feishu-ingest 1.0.3

- No code changes in this release.
- Documentation (SKILL.md) updated for improved clarity and structure.
- No changes to core logic, features, or configuration.
- Safe to upgrade; behavior is unchanged.

- Clarified that Feishu content is often fragmented and requires explicit mapping into the knowledge graph before archiving.
- Added guidance: OpenClaw should first determine which items deserve entity pages and which existing pages need to be updated, instead of blindly archiving low-value chat content.
- Expanded required linking: when updating/creating pages, also maintain relatedPages for general Wiki entities (besides relatedConcepts, Resources, CodePages).
- Introduced overview/ page type for team-level navigation, project maps, or research directions; advised not to create overview pages without clear value.
- Improved documentation on content curation criteria and navigation/overview page creation.

- Clarified that "group files" are only handled if they appear as message resources (file/image), not by crawling the group files directory; folders are now returned as unsupported.
- Updated documentation to specify that file/folder messages are recognized distinctly, with unsupported types explicitly marked.
- Enhanced skipResult/prepare apply phase documentation for error feedback and diagnosis.
- Minor improvements to output result description, including how source item status statistics are handled for frontend cards.
- Refined some phrasing and removed redundancy for improved clarity.

Initial release of feishu_ingest – a skill for structured ingestion of Feishu group messages and files into a Research KB.

- Polls Feishu groups for new messages, files, and cloud docs; compiles into Markdown sources with metadata.
- Provides a two-phase "prepare/apply" workflow: gather/prepare source materials, then validate and ingest into Gitea-backed knowledge base.
- Robust error handling for permissions, unsupported types, and large files; clear status reporting.
- Integrates with OpenClaw for context analysis and page generation.
- Modular script structure for extensibility and maintainability; unified Feishu and Gitea API clients.
- Granular configuration for source scanning, grouping, filtering, and file/document handling.
